addons.name: ChatKeep
addons.changelog: 1.0: no changes since 0.1.0; works in game

addons.name: FlightLog
addons.changelog: Ships with known flight times for 10 routes, so new installs show times before your first flight.

addons.name: LevelLog
addons.changelog: Zone quest tracking tracks every quest that belongs to your zone (by its header or objectives/turn-in on the zone map) and untracks the rest. /ll export shows live played time for the level you are on.

addons.name: PriceLog
addons.changelog: Leveler: works without AH prices (uses recipes whose reagents have no price yet instead of 'No recipe gives points'); no longer breaks leathers down into scraps or the grade below

app.changelog: Add CurseForge addon: paste an addon's link from curseforge.com to install it and keep it updated. Remove from list stops updating one.
